01 · About

Hi, I'm Natalie.

I'm an Austin-based creator known for personality-driven comedy, cultural storytelling, and relatable takes on everyday life: immigrant-parent POVs, family dynamics, food, fashion, travel, and relationships.

My audience comes for the humor and stays for my personality, which makes brand integrations feel like part of the content instead of traditional advertising.
